editorial:
Imagine waking up in a city where everyone has suddenly gone crazy and wants to eat you alive. You follow a reporter and his doctor wife who are just trying to survive while the world falls apart around them. The vibe is pure chaos, with crowds of bloodthirsty people running through the streets like a nightmare you cannot wake up from. It feels like a wild ride because the movie does not waste any time getting straight to the action and the gore. You get a sense of total panic as the military tries to hold the line, but they are losing badly against the undead hordes.

What really pops is the fast pace and the over-the-top violence that makes it feel like a comic book. The acting is a bit stiff, but that actually adds to the charm of these old Italian horror flicks. If you love old-school practical effects and non-stop shouting, you will have a blast. You should definitely grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see all the blood in high detail, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends. It is a perfect pick for a lazy Saturday.
endingExplained: The movie ends with the military realizing they cannot stop the infection with normal weapons. The reporter and his wife manage to survive the madness, but the city is completely lost. The army decides the only way to stop the spread is to use nuclear bombs to wipe everything out. You see the massive explosions clear the area, leaving a wasteland behind. It is a bleak ending because while our main characters live, the world as they knew it is gone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old zombie movies and crazy action.
